| lockbox_mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| lockbox_min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| fold14_mdd | **-9.31%** | -9.97% |
| worst_mdd | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Observations

1. **Champion holds** — better tuning consistency (min 0.43 vs 0.05) and tighter drawdown control
2. **Candidate strength** — improved lockbox_min (+19%) suggests better tail robustness on unseen data
3. **Risk flag** — candidate's worst_mdd (-11.2%) exceeds fold14_mdd, indicating instability on another fold

## Ready for Next Cycle

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

Proceed when ready. 🚀
